column12: The incense of his virtues, delighted our souls, like the blossomed aroma, in the Paradise.

column12: Truly you were greatly exalted, in the midst of the council, of our Orthodox fathers, in the city of Ephesus.

column4: وأخزيت نسطور البطريرك المنافق واعترفت الاعتراف الحسن.

column12: + You embarrassed Nestorius, the impious patriarch, and you have confessed, the good confession.
